text:
Elaine: Quick idea — run a 3-day microthread series with 3 external ambassadors for the launch next week. keep it lightweight.
Sam: Love it. X + LinkedIn double-tease? ambassadors: @harper, @tay, @ritesh — ok?
Harper: I can do a personal thread + one amplified post. need one-pager assets and 2 quote variations.
Ritesh: I'll take LinkedIn carousel (3 slides). need hero image + 3 slide images and suggested copy.
Tay: Timing thoughts — PST mornings work best for me. suggest CTA -> webinar signup or demo link.
Elaine: Draft schedule proposal: Day1 hero post (X) 9:00am PST, Day2 ambassador thread (Harper) 10:00am PST, Day3 LinkedIn carousel (Ritesh) 12:00pm PST. I'll share a sheet for slots.
Sam: Please include UTMs: utm_campaign=amb_launch&utm_source=ambassador&utm_medium=social&utm_content={ambassador}.
SocialBot: Heads up — scheduled posts need to be in Buffer by EOD Thu to pass approvals. link: https://app.buffer.com/ :calendar: 
Tay: Asset request for Design: can we get hero + 3 slides + square variants? sizes needed: 1200x628, 1080x1080. tagging @Design.
Design: Noted. We'll do hero (1200x628) + 3 slides (1080x1080) + a short 30s clip placeholder. ETA Wed EOD.
Harper: Draft copy options — 1) "We just shipped a new way to run LLM inference at production scale" 2) "Latency, cost, and reliability — how we made inference predictable". Will A/B test lead sentence.
Sam: Engagement plan: 1) like top replies 2) reply with follow-up thread linking to webinar 3) pin top replies and convert into lead outreach.
Elaine: Routing for inbound signups: send to SDR Queue with tag #amb-launch and ambassador name in notes. can someone confirm SDR template?
SDR Queue: Confirmed. Use template: "Hey — noticed you signed up from Harper's thread. Quick q: are you evaluating inference infra or just researching?" Assign within 2 hours during business hours.
Ritesh: Also can Design do a 30s clip (screen + captions) for X reels after images? if not, we'll drop static first.
Design: Clip depends on bandwidth. We'll prioritize static assets, then short clip if time permits.
Tay: Moderation volunteers? someone to scan replies day-of and surface high-intent leads. I can cover evenings.
Harper: I can moderate mornings and highlight top comments.
Sam: I'll build a tiny tracking doc with engagement metrics (clicks, signups, reply volume) and share.
Elaine: Final checklist: assets due Wed EOD, Buffer queue by Thu noon, SDR template ready, UTMs applied. tagging everyone — I'll upload the sheet now. :rocket:
